column1: # Results and missing inputs: P/AC-R047; qualification of evidence bindings: P/AC-R050 and Platform/common/acceptance/seams.md.
# The inventory of the target P/01/production (N6 of spec/acceptance.norms.md; the Architect's answer on P01.86): the 17 case groups and the 13 probes, one row each.
# The rows name the entries and add no outcome: the observed outcomes are in the row of the source. kind: group or probe. source: the row that owns the entry.
# executed_by: the probe that executes a group as its initial state or stage, - when the entry is executed by itself; the result is shown under both names (P/AC-R040).
# inputs: JSON array of what the entry needs, closed words: a D7 capability (clock, storage, progress, fault), a field of the input of N6.2 (manager, volume),

# a key of its budgets, group (the store group stand) or a means of the engine (two_way_partition, raft_snapshot); [] — the entry needs no input of these words. The D7 capabilities of an entry are those of its rows in forms/production/bindings.tsv.

# A missing or unapproved need gives not_executed with its specific word as the reason (N6.5); inspect non-group inputs first, then budget terms, and use group only as the fallback for a missing runnable group stand. group on keys.store_build: box gives not_applicable; unknown build mode gives store_build. Record all missing inputs, not a claim that a present README is absent.

# prod-clock-group on shared wall clocks has reason clock before group; prod-disk-fd full-disk needs an external system-call observer (missing: storage), its FD slice needs active exhaustion evidence. replay_limit measures replay processing in its declared unit; admin_connections counts admitted open admin.sock connections. Their independent transport/FD limits must not mask the tested boundary.

# term: JSON array of the budget names of its row (first approved budgets), the keys of N6.2, the constants of the runtime-constants form or leader_wait (the effective -leader-wait); [] — the outcome is judged.
